# MCP server builder (Anthropic)

Build well-designed MCP servers in Python or TypeScript that wrap an external API.

- Source: https://github.com/anthropics/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/skills/main/skills/mcp-builder/SKILL.md
- Author: Anthropic
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/mcp-server-builder-anthropic-ab90b905

A step-by-step guide for creating Model Context Protocol servers so agents can call an outside service through clean, well-named tools. It covers researching the target API, designing tools for agents rather than humans, implementing with FastMCP (Python) or the MCP TypeScript SDK, and testing with the MCP Inspector. Reference docs for each SDK and best-practice notes are bundled, along with an evaluation workflow that writes realistic test questions for the finished server.

**Try asking:**
- "Build an MCP server for our internal ticketing REST API in TypeScript"
- "Wrap the Airtable API as an MCP server with FastMCP"
- "Review my MCP server's tool names and descriptions"
